text:
carmen: Quick sync: debating error handling pattern for the new 'Create Pipeline' modal. Two options: pure inline (field-level) vs. a sticky summary bar. Accessibility and mobile density are our big constraints. riju: Short take: hybrid. Inline for single errors, but show a compact sticky summary when there are >=2 failures so keyboard users get a single focus target. oya: +1 hybrid. Important to make the summary meaningful for screen reader users. Should announce number of errors and allow jump to first error. ben: Implementation note: summary should be focusable and calling summaryEl.focus() should land before the rest of the modal content so tab order is predictable. Also add an aria-describedby that points at an sr-only explanation. carmen: Example accessible snippet we can reuse: ```html

2 errors found. Press Enter to jump to the first field.

``` oya: Small copy nit: avoid passive tones. Use "Add a pipeline name" instead of "Name missing". Actionable copy reduces cognitive load. riju: Mobile constraint: summary takes vertical space. My proposal: show a single-line pill at top with badge "2 errors" + chevron. Tapping expands in place to full text. Inline errors still visible beneath fields. ben: For required markers: visible asterisk + visually-hidden "required" label and aria-required="true" on the input. We should not rely solely on color. aria-bot: Accessibility scan results: missing aria-live on current modal error area, required inputs without aria-required, and no keyboard focus on error summary. Issues logged to ticket FE-781. carmen: Destructive actions tie-in: when a form includes delete/drop actions (e.g., delete pipeline + tasks), we should determine confirmation strength by risk. Proposal: typed-confirm for resources marked "production" OR with >3 downstream jobs OR size > 500MB. For smaller/dev items, use a checkbox + explicit verb in button: "Delete pipeline" not just "Confirm". oya: Agree. Also add an inline hint about who will be affected: "This will stop X jobs and remove Y artifacts." Quantified context helps avoid surprise. riju: For the typed-confirm UX keep it consistent: case-insensitive match, trim whitespace, show tooltip on wrong input. Avoid too strict patterns like regex unless necessary. ben: Action items: 1) Design to update modal mock with error pill + expanded summary pattern (mobile + desktop). 2) Dev to add focusable error-summary component with aria-live. 3) Product to confirm typed-confirm thresholds. 4) Copy deck to be updated to action-oriented errors. carmen: I'll push a refreshed figma with both desktop and mobile variants and leave comments for dev. Let's pick this up tomorrow during async review. Thanks! :sparkles:
